note: _audivimus enim eum dicentem: quoniam Iesus Nazarenis hic_ (…) – for we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth (…). Two remarks: **(1)** the colon should be placed before, rather than after quoniam (see the glossary s.v. quoniam; and above, on Acts 2:13, for a similar case). – **(2)** _hic_ has derogatory force, echoing the Greek.
